label: 1 John 1:1
text: That which was from the beginning, which the writer hath heard, which he hath seen with his eyes, which he hath looked upon, and his hands have handled, of me, the Word of life;

label: 1 John 1:2
text: (For I was manifested, and he hath seen me, and beareth witness, and sheweth unto you that eternal life, which was with my Father, and was manifested unto him;)

label: 1 John 1:3
text: That which he hath seen and heard he declareth unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with him: and truly his fellowship is with my Father, and with me.

label: 1 John 1:4
text: And these things he writeth unto you, that your joy may be full.

label: 1 John 1:5
text: This then is the message which he hath heard of me, and declareth unto you, that I am light, and in me is no darkness at all.

label: 1 John 1:6
text: If ye say that ye have fellowship with me, and walk in darkness, ye lie, and do not the truth:

label: 1 John 1:7
text: But if ye walk in the light, as I am in the light, ye have fellowship one with another, and my blood cleanseth you from all sin.

label: 1 John 1:8
text: If ye say that ye have no sin, ye deceive yourselves, and the truth is not in you.

label: 1 John 1:9
text: If ye confess your sins, I am faithful and just to forgive you your sins, and to cleanse you from all unrighteousness.

label: 1 John 1:10
text: If ye say that ye have not sinned, ye make me a liar, and my word is not in you.

label: 1 John 2:1
text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, ye have an advocate with my Father, even me, the righteous:

label: 1 John 2:2
text: And I am the propitiation for your sins: and not for yours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

label: 1 John 2:3
text: And hereby ye do know that ye know me, if ye keep my commandments.

label: 1 John 2:4
text: He that saith that he knoweth me, and keepeth not my commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

label: 1 John 2:5
text: But whoso keepeth my word, in him verily is my love perfected: hereby know ye that ye are in me.

label: 1 John 2:6
text: He that saith that he abideth in me ought himself also so to walk, even as I walked.

label: 1 John 2:7
text: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

label: 1 John 2:8
text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in me and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

label: 1 John 2:9
text: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

label: 1 John 2:10
text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

label: 1 John 2:11
text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

label: 1 John 2:12
text: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for my name's sake.

label: 1 John 2:13
text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known me that am from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known my Father.

label: 1 John 2:14
text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known me that am from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and my word abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

label: 1 John 2:15
text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of my Father is not in him.

label: 1 John 2:16
text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of my Father, but is of the world.

label: 1 John 2:17
text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth my will abideth for ever.

label: 1 John 2:18
text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby ye know that it is the last time.

label: 1 John 2:19
text: They went out from you, but they were not of you; for if they had been of you, they would no doubt have continued with you: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of you.

label: 1 John 2:20
text: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

label: 1 John 2:21
text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

label: 1 John 2:22
text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that I am the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

label: 1 John 2:23
text: Whosoever denieth me, the same hath not my Father: but he that acknowledgeth me hath my Father also.

label: 1 John 2:24
text: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in me, and in my Father.

label: 1 John 2:25
text: And this is the promise that I have promised you, even eternal life.

label: 1 John 2:26
text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

label: 1 John 2:27
text: But the anointing which ye have received of me abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in me.

label: 1 John 2:28
text: And now, little children, abide in me; that, when I shall appear, ye may have confidence, and not be ashamed before me at my coming.

label: 1 John 2:29
text: If ye know that I am righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of me.

label: 1 John 3:1
text: Behold, what manner of love my Father hath bestowed upon you, that ye should be called the sons of my Father: therefore the world knoweth you not, because it knew me not.

label: 1 John 3:2
text: Beloved, now are ye the sons of my Father, and it doth not yet appear what ye shall be: but ye know that, when I shall appear, ye shall be like me; for ye shall see me as I am.

label: 1 John 3:3
text: And every man that hath this hope in me purifieth himself, even as I am pure.

label: 1 John 3:4
text: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

label: 1 John 3:5
text: And ye know that I was manifested to take away your sins; and in me is no sin.

label: 1 John 3:6
text: Whosoever abideth in me sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen me, neither known me.

label: 1 John 3:7
text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as I am righteous.

label: 1 John 3:8
text: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose I, the Son of God, was manifested, that I might destroy the works of the devil.

label: 1 John 3:9
text: Whosoever is born of my Father doth not commit sin; for my Father's seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of my Father.

label: 1 John 3:10
text: In this the children of my Father are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of my Father, neither he that loveth not his brother.

label: 1 John 3:11
text: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that ye should love one another.

label: 1 John 3:12
text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

label: 1 John 3:13
text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

label: 1 John 3:14
text: Ye know that ye have passed from death unto life, because ye love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

label: 1 John 3:15
text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

label: 1 John 3:16
text: Hereby perceive ye my love, because I laid down my life for you: and ye ought to lay down your lives for the brethren.

label: 1 John 3:17
text: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth my love in him?

label: 1 John 3:18
text: My little children, love not in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

label: 1 John 3:19
text: And hereby ye know that ye are of the truth, and shall assure your hearts before me.

label: 1 John 3:20
text: For if your heart condemn you, my Father is greater than your heart, and knoweth all things.

label: 1 John 3:21
text: Beloved, if your heart condemn you not, then have ye confidence toward my Father.

label: 1 John 3:22
text: And whatsoever ye ask, ye receive of me, because ye keep my commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in my sight.

label: 1 John 3:23
text: And this is my commandment, That ye should believe on my name, and love one another, as I gave you commandment.

label: 1 John 3:24
text: And he that keepeth my commandments dwelleth in me, and I in him. And hereby ye know that I abide in you, by the Spirit which I have given you.

label: 1 John 4:1
text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of me: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

label: 1 John 4:2
text: Hereby know ye my Spirit: Every spirit that confesseth that I am come in the flesh is of me:

label: 1 John 4:3
text: And every spirit that confesseth not that I am come in the flesh is not of me: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

label: 1 John 4:4
text: Ye are of me, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

label: 1 John 4:5
text: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

label: 1 John 4:6
text: Ye are of my Father: he that knoweth my Father heareth you; he that is not of my Father heareth you not. Hereby know ye the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

label: 1 John 4:7
text: Beloved, love ye one another: for love is of my Father; and every one that loveth is born of my Father, and knoweth my Father.

label: 1 John 4:8
text: He that loveth not knoweth not my Father; for my Father is love.

label: 1 John 4:9
text: In this was manifested the love of my Father toward you, because that my Father sent me, his only begotten Son, into the world, that ye might live through me.

label: 1 John 4:10
text: Herein is love, not that ye loved my Father, but that my Father loved you, and sent me to be the propitiation for your sins.

label: 1 John 4:11
text: Beloved, if my Father so loved you, ye ought also to love one another.

label: 1 John 4:12
text: No man hath seen my Father at any time. If ye love one another, my Father dwelleth in you, and his love is perfected in you.

label: 1 John 4:13
text: Hereby know ye that ye dwell in me, and I in you, because I have given you of my Spirit.

label: 1 John 4:14
text: And the writer hath seen and doth testify that my Father sent me to be the Saviour of the world.

label: 1 John 4:15
text: Whosoever shall confess that I am the Son of God, I dwell in him, and he in me.

label: 1 John 4:16
text: And ye have known and believed the love that my Father hath to you. My Father is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in my Father, and my Father in him.

label: 1 John 4:17
text: Herein is your love made perfect, that ye may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as I am, so are ye in this world.

label: 1 John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

label: 1 John 4:19
text: Ye love my Father, because my Father first loved you.

label: 1 John 4:20
text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

label: 1 John 4:21
text: And this commandment have ye from me, That he who loveth my Father love his brother also.

label: 1 John 5:1
text: Whosoever believeth that I am the Christ is born of my Father: and every one that loveth my Father that begat loveth him also that is begotten of my Father.

label: 1 John 5:2
text: By this ye know that ye love the children of my Father, when ye love my Father, and keep his commandments.

label: 1 John 5:3
text: For this is the love of my Father, that ye keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

label: 1 John 5:4
text: For whatsoever is born of my Father overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even your faith.

label: 1 John 5:5
text: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that I am the Son of God?

label: 1 John 5:6
text: I came by water and blood; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

label: 1 John 5:7
text: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

label: 1 John 5:8
text: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

label: 1 John 5:9
text: If ye receive the witness of men, the witness of my Father is greater: for this is the witness of my Father which he hath testified of me.

label: 1 John 5:10
text: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not my Father hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that my Father gave of me.

label: 1 John 5:11
text: And this is the record, that my Father hath given to you eternal life, and this life is in me.

label: 1 John 5:12
text: He that hath me hath life; and he that hath not me hath not life.

label: 1 John 5:13
text: These things have I written unto you that believe on my name; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on my name.

label: 1 John 5:14
text: And this is the confidence that ye have in me, that, if ye ask any thing according to my will, I hear you:

label: 1 John 5:15
text: And if ye know that I hear you, whatsoever ye ask, ye know that ye have the petitions that ye desired of me.

label: 1 John 5:16
text: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and I shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

label: 1 John 5:17
text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

label: 1 John 5:18
text: Ye know that whosoever is born of my Father sinneth not; but he that is begotten of my Father keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

label: 1 John 5:19
text: And ye know that ye are of my Father, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

label: 1 John 5:20
text: And ye know that I, the Son of God, am come, and have given you an understanding, that ye may know him that is true, and ye are in him that is true, even in me. I am the true God, and eternal life.

label: 1 John 5:21
text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
